headline: PICK RUSH: the night shift now changes character
lede: The sorting floor doesn't sound like the same room at 4 a.m. — and it never should. Per-shift ambience landed on PICK RUSH: distant forklift chirps on the early floor, pneumatics waking with the glass era, and relay chatter over a deep drone at the graveyard peak, with the motor bed deepening every shift and an air-brake whoosh on each whistle.

notes.text: Three ambience eras keyed to the shifts — beeps tighten 540→420→330 ticks as the night wears on, the hum bed deepens 0.05→0.07, and the shift whistle gets an air-brake whoosh. Pure schedule: sim, autopilot, replays and hashes never see it.

pickcheck gained 9 AMB gates (zone map, tightening cadence, exact schedule, era bleed, play-door in Node; attract-silent, live beep-at-tick and graveyard-chatter proofs in Chrome) — 36/36 node, 17/17 browser, and PICK_MUT=amb goes red on two named gates.

PLAICRAFT #1711 audit: every remaining line is Jon-side — his 3 phone takes, the read-key file (#2218), and the SESSION_WRITE_KEY deploy that audit #2142 orders first (jonq #2233, live /status still says writeKey:false).

Never-dry pick: flagship READMEs are gap-free, so the stage went to the shelf's weakest title by score — PICK RUSH, 5. Its episode-export gap got its stale 'waits on #1141' note corrected: that kit shipped.
